# ggsegBuckner

Buckner cerebellar functional parcellation for the ggseg ecosystem.

## Installation

We recommend installing the ggseg-atlases through the ggseg
[r-universe](https://ggseg.r-universe.dev/ui#builds):

``` r
options(repos = c(
  ggseg = "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))

install.packages("ggsegBuckner")
```

You can install this package from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ggsegverse/ggsegBuckner")
```

## 7-network parcellation

``` r
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegBuckner)

plot(buckner7())
```

![](reference/figures/README-buckner7-1.png)

## 17-network parcellation

``` r
plot(buckner17())
```

![](reference/figures/README-buckner17-1.png)

## Data source

Buckner RL et al. (2011). The organization of the human cerebellum
estimated by intrinsic functional connectivity. *Journal of
Neurophysiology*, 106(5), 2322-2345.

# Package index

## Atlases

Brain atlases bundled in this package

- [`buckner17()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegBuckner/reference/buckner17.md)
  : Buckner 17-Network Cerebellar Parcellation
- [`buckner7()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegBuckner/reference/buckner7.md)
  : Buckner 7-Network Cerebellar Parcellation
